001package com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.historyLog;
002
003import org.apache.commons.lang3.Validate;
004import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.annotations.HistoryLogProps;
005import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.helpers.Bytes;
006
007import java.math.BigInteger;
008
009/**
010 * History log record USB Enumerated, opCode 67, size 26.
011 *
012 * <br>
013 *
014 * 
015 * <table border='1'>
016 * <caption>Message properties:</caption>
017 * <tr><th>&nbsp;<code>opCode</code>&nbsp;</th><td>&nbsp;<code>67</code>&nbsp;</td></tr>
018 * <tr><th>&nbsp;<code>displayName</code>&nbsp;</th><td>&nbsp;<code>"USB Enumerated"</code>&nbsp;</td></tr>
019 * <tr><th>&nbsp;<code>usedByTidepool</code>&nbsp;</th><td>&nbsp;<code>true</code>&nbsp;</td></tr>
020 * </table>
021 */
022@HistoryLogProps(
023    opCode = 67,
024    displayName = "USB Enumerated",
025    usedByTidepool = true
026)
027public class UsbEnumeratedHistoryLog extends HistoryLog {
028    
029    private int negotiatedCurrentMilliAmps;
030    
031    public UsbEnumeratedHistoryLog() {}
032    public UsbEnumeratedHistoryLog(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int negotiatedCurrentMilliAmps) {
033        super(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum);
034        this.cargo = buildCargo(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, negotiatedCurrentMilliAmps);
035        this.negotiatedCurrentMilliAmps = negotiatedCurrentMilliAmps;
036        
037    }
038
039    public UsbEnumeratedHistoryLog(int negotiatedCurrentMilliAmps) {
040        this(0, 0, negotiatedCurrentMilliAmps);
041    }
042
043    public int typeId() {
044        return 67;
045    }
046
047    /**
048     * <table border="1">
049     * <caption>Parsed fields for UsbEnumeratedHistoryLog:</caption>
050     * <tr><td><code>negotiatedCurrentMilliAmps</code></td><td><code>raw[10]</code></td></tr>
051     * </table>
052     */
053    public void parse(byte[] raw) {
054        Validate.isTrue(raw.length == 26);
055        this.cargo = raw;
056        parseBase(raw);
057        this.negotiatedCurrentMilliAmps = raw[10];
058        
059    }
060
061    public static byte[] buildCargo(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int negotiatedCurrentMilliAmps) {
062        return HistoryLog.fillCargo(Bytes.combine(
063            HistoryLog.typeIdBytes(67, 0),
064            Bytes.toUint32(pumpTimeSec),
065            Bytes.toUint32(sequenceNum),
066            new byte[]{ (byte) negotiatedCurrentMilliAmps }));
067    }
068    public int getNegotiatedCurrentMilliAmps() {
069        return negotiatedCurrentMilliAmps;
070    }
071    
072}
